business_summary: Jiayou International Logistics Co.,Ltd engages in the provision of cross-border multimodal transport integrated logistics services. It offers supply chain trade services, and land port operation services. The company is involved in import and export of goods, agency, and technology; international freight forwarding by sea, air, and land; non-vessel operating common carrier (NVOCC) services; information consulting; and warehousing services. It operates in China-Mongolia, Central Asia, Africa, Central and South America, and internationally. Jiayou International Logistics Co.,Ltd was founded in 2005 and is based in Beijing, China.
